summary: Iteration 9 — Group B Delivery Flow Rework FRONTEND testing complete. All 8 scenarios in the review request PASS end-to-end against the public preview URL. Verified: (1) Settings → Delivery Cities section (data-testid new-city-input / add-city-btn / delete-city-<name>) works — add + delete + row-appears/disappears confirmed. (2) NewOrder → toggle Delivery Required → City field rendered as DROPDOWN (data-testid delivery-city-select), populated by /api/cities (Chennai, Bengaluru and other seeded cities all visible in list). Fallback text input (delivery-city-input-fallback) correctly not shown when cities exist. (3) ManageOrders → seeded Order A (is_ready=true, no actual_cake_image_url, needs_delivery=true) shows EXACTLY ONE 'Upload Image' button with data-testid upload-image-btn-<orderId>. Zero 'Ready to Deliver' text-only buttons for that order. Clicking Upload Image opens camera/upload dialog. (4) ManageOrders → seeded Order B (needs_delivery=false, status=ready_to_deliver) shows orange 'Add Delivery' button (data-testid add-delivery-btn-<orderId>). Clicking opens the 4-step wizard dialog. All 4 steps and every data-testid present (add-delivery-zone-select, step1-next, complementary, charge-input, step2-next, receiver-name/phone, address, city-select, step3-next, person-select, submit-add-delivery). (5) NEGATIVE: submitting delivery_charge=75 → red error banner 'Delivery charge must be a multiple of ₹50 (or 0 for complementary)' rendered (400 from backend surfaced correctly to user). (6) POSITIVE: submitting delivery_charge=100 + delivery user assigned → success banner 'Delivery added to order', dialog closes, order shows 'Out for Delivery' + delivery ₹100 line in payment column. (7) DeliveryDashboard → primary-contact-<orderId> block shows Receiver X name + Receiver badge FIRST, phone 8888888888 as tel: link, customer info 'Customer: TEST UI9 Customer — 7777777777' as secondary line below. (8) OTP: mark-delivered-btn opens Verify OTP dialog; wrong OTP → 'Invalid OTP' error via data-testid delivery-otp-error; correct OTP (330552 fetched via /orders/manage) → dialog closes, order shows 'Delivered Successfully'.

design_issues.screen: ManageOrders — order row (Order B) actions cell
issues: The Status Select trigger next to 'Add Delivery' is severely truncated to 'Ready to...' at 1920×1080 (Actions column too narrow). Not a bug — just UX. Consider widening Actions column or hiding the label in narrow viewports.

critical_code_review_comments: ManageOrders.js is now 2789 lines — the Add Delivery wizard added ~200 lines inside an already-large file. Consider extracting the wizard (steps 1-4, state, submit handler) into a separate component (e.g., AddDeliveryWizard.jsx) to keep ManageOrders below ~2000 lines.

The 'Ready to Deliver' cyan status badge in the Status column visually looks like a button because of its filled-pill style. Not a functional bug but users may click it expecting an action. Consider giving it a distinctly non-interactive style (rounded-full, non-hoverable, muted).
DeliveryDashboard.js primary-contact block correctly hides the receiver Customer: line if customer_info.phone === receiver.phone. Good.

The Upload Image button condition `order.is_ready && !order.actual_cake_image_url` does NOT check needs_delivery — so a non-delivery order can also show Upload Image, which is the intended behavior per spec. Confirmed working.

add-delivery-charge-input uses type='number' step='50' which some browsers will auto-round to nearest 50 with spinner but allow arbitrary values via keyboard (as observed with 75). This is fine because backend validates, but frontend could add its own client-side gate (%50 check) to give instant feedback before submit.
